query: SELECT m.source_page, m.source_question_number, COUNT(o.id) AS option_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_correct) AS correct_count FROM public.gk_mcqs m LEFT JOIN public.gk_mcq_options o ON o.mcq_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608 GROUP BY m.source_page, m.source_question_number ORDER BY m.source_page, m.source_question_number LIMIT 50;
